svg.title: White Black (Petit Dolmen)
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. All black wedges are paint on a continuous white rectangular canvas, not missing support. External photograph margin omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2019/contemporary-art-day-n10070/lot.139.html; record sothebys-en-auctions-ecatalogue-2019-contemporary-art-day-n10070-lot-139-html; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
